name: Tom Olson
sources: John Howard Adams, "John Howard Adams - A Memoir" (privately printed)
notes: Megan Adams’s maternal grandfather, called "Umpa". Father of Kris Olson (Falde), Tom Olson and Sigrid Olson.
He loved to drive and was saddened when he could no longer do so. [John Howard Adams, A Memoir, text line 3708]
